subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood + Aperture Labs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood + Aperture Labs

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the discovery call today — great to learn more about Aperture's vector search / semantic search use cases and the QPS targets you mentioned. As discussed, the next best step is a technical deep-dive / architecture review so our solutions engineer and lead infra engineer can walk through how Redwood would fit into your stack.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 15 min: short recap of goals & current architecture
- 30 min: architecture review + integration patterns (envs, auth, data flow, KV cache)
- 15 min: questions, performance & SLA considerations

Proposed times (all PT):
- Tue 24 Mar — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 24 Mar — 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 25 Mar — 09:00–10:00 PT

Attendees from our side: me (AM), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer), Jonas Weber (Lead Infra). Please let me know which time works best and whether any internal folks (CTO/engineering) should join. We can record the session and share the slide/notes afterward.

I've attached a short agenda (RDW_TechDeepDive_Agenda.pdf) and will send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: RDW_TechDeepDive_Agenda.pdf

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — this looks good. Quick note on scheduling: our CTO Michael Reyes and our security/compliance lead (for SOC2 questions) would like to join. Also, our preferred time on that week is Tue 24 Mar but at 10:00 ET (which is 07:00 PT for you). Is it possible to do 24 Mar 10:00–11:00 ET? If that's tough for your team, we can do 24 Mar 13:00–14:00 ET as an alternative.

We'd like the session recorded and for the agenda to include a short compliance Q&A (15 min) so we can cover data residency, logging, and retention.

If you can send a calendar invite that includes dial-in + recording link, that would be great.

Thanks —

Morning team —

Confirmed for Tue 24 Mar 10:00 ET (07:00 PT). I'll prepare a short deck focused on integration patterns (API auth, streaming vs batch, KV cache warm-up), expected throughput tuning, and quantization/latency tradeoffs. Notes for the session:
- Bring concrete examples of their current ingestion pipeline (S3/DB triggers) if possible.
- We'll reserve the last 15 minutes for compliance questions — Jonas can cover logging/audit and I can cover data flows.
- Will enable recording and include links in the calendar invite.

Marissa — if you want, I can drop a 1-pager on expected token costs by workload ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Dylan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
